message.content:
Yes, you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise complaints are typically handled by the City’s **Department of Public Safety** or the local police department. Here’s how you can do it:

1. **Online Complaint Form**  
   - Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website at [https://www.atlantaga.gov](https://www.atlantaga.gov).  
   - Navigate to the “Public Safety” section and look for “Noise Complaints.”  
   - Fill out the online form with details such as the location, time, and nature of the noise.

2. **Phone**  
   - Call the City of Atlanta Police Department’s non-emergency line at **(404) 656-4000**.  
   - You can also call the City’s 311 service at **(404) 656-3111** for general inquiries and to be directed to the appropriate department.

3. **In-Person**  
   - If you prefer to speak directly with an officer, you can visit the nearest police precinct.  
   - For example, the Midtown Precinct is located at 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309.

4. **Mail**  
   - Send a written complaint to the City of Atlanta Police Department, Attn: Noise Enforcement, 1000 Peachtree Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30309.

When filing your complaint, be sure to include:
- Exact address or intersection of the noisy location.
- Time and duration of the noise.
- Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction).
- Any evidence you have (audio recordings, photos).

After submitting your complaint, the City will investigate and take appropriate action. If the noise continues after the initial investigation, you may follow up with the same contact points.
